lines.speaker: olive
lines.text: Whooo's there? Welcome to the Treehouse! Let your imagination soar up here!

lines.speaker: olive
lines.text: Olive tucked her wings in close and opened a well-loved book. Outside, the evening turned gold.

lines.speaker: olive
lines.text: "Once," she read, "there was a small creature who could not sleep. So the tree grew a room just for resting."

lines.speaker: olive
lines.text: "It had round windows for watching the sky, and lanterns that never burned too bright."

lines.speaker: olive
lines.text: Olive closed the book softly. "That room is this one," she said. "Stay as long as you like."
